title: RAW UNREVIEWED: rhyme and reason-negation jointly constrain a shared phonological reading
summary: Retain a rhyme-bearing technical verse hypothesis in which one shared nonalphabet-presupposing phonological key must jointly recover complete wording, rhyme and reason-negation scope. The owned Karlsruhe88v source distinguishes not because it burns from it does not burn; neither rhyme nor fluent paraphrase alone selects meaning.

design.hypothesis: A declared complete technical verse unit encodes source-language words through one shared sublexical key. Rhyme constrains stressed endings while full syntax separately distinguishes NOT(REASON(BURNS,FIERY_NAME)) from NOT(BURNS). Lexical spelling/phonological analyses remain tied to attested source words, not invented whole-word operations.
design.owned_observation: SOURCE_NEGATION_QUALIFICATION preserves approximate Der xi himel ob in / sol furin genant sin / Nit dar umb dz er brenne / [Sin?] liechte hie bekenne and the following shining/fire comparison. The source explicitly denies burning as reason for the name; categorical nonburning is a stronger contextual premise. Approximate brenne/bekenne is a prospective rhyme analysis, not a secure phonetic annotation.
design.changed_contract: Unlike911 quantitative metre, require jointly conserved stressed rhyme relations and proposition scope across complete clauses under one key. Unlike the old f85 couplet count, do not infer a reading order from rhyme. Unlike560, categorical NOT(BURNS) is not donated by the source. A formal scope witness and sublexical reuse are required in addition to metrical compatibility.
design.discriminating_data_path: A future bounded source-only native annotation of the already owned full Karlsruhe88v local unit must freeze uncertain spelling, complete clauses, stressed rhyme alternatives and their scope. Root would then nominate an already owned complete target unit only if verse boundaries/order have evidence independent of the desired source story. Require a second complete consumer to reuse the same observed key and reason connective, without new whole-word values. No new source/image access is requested here.
design.falsifier: Reject the declared witness if no shared key recovers complete lexical wording and frozen rhyme, if the scope analysis entails categorical nonburning only by an unwritten premise, or if transfer requires new syllable values/verse boundaries. Equally valid rival scope or polarity readings yield ambiguity, not a selected translation.
